sources.subject: sheet of eight carved walnut bookshop category signs, cream-and-gold serif lettering (invented shop signage)
sources.prompt: A flat, straight-on, evenly lit product sheet of EIGHT separate hand-painted wooden bookshop category signs for an independent prairie bookshop, arranged in an exact grid of 2 columns by 4 rows on a plain flat charcoal-grey background, with equal clear gaps of background between the signs and a generous empty margin around the whole grid. Every sign is exactly the same size: a landscape rectangle three times as wide as it is tall, filling its grid cell. Each sign is a dark stained walnut board with a thin carved bevelled border, warm aged varnish and faint wood grain, lettered in large, clean, centred cream-and-gold serif capitals in classic sign-writer style, perfectly legible and spelled exactly as given, with no other words. Row 1, left: "FICTION"; row 1, right: "LOCAL HISTORY". Row 2, left: "MAPS & TRAVEL"; row 2, right: "CHILDREN'S BOOKS". Row 3, left: "RARE BOOKS"; row 3, right: "POETRY". Row 4, left: "PRAIRIE AUTHORS"; row 4, right: "NEW & NOTABLE". Front-on orthographic view with no perspective, no cast shadows, no hanging chains or hooks, no hands, no people, no logos, no watermark, no extra text.

sources.subject: two area rugs seen from above: a worn Persian-style reading-room rug, a children's prairie play rug
sources.prompt: A flat, top-down, straight-down orthographic texture sheet of TWO separate rectangular area rugs side by side on a plain flat charcoal-grey background, each rug filling one half of the image with an equal clear gap between them and an even empty margin all round, evenly lit with no shadows and no perspective. Left rug: a worn traditional wool reading-room rug with a Persian-style medallion and border pattern in deep madder red, ochre, navy and cream, slightly faded, short fringe at both short ends. Right rug: a cheerful children's-corner play rug in soft primary colours, a simple pattern of stylised prairie hills, a winding river, little trees and stars, low-pile and slightly worn. Both rugs are landscape rectangles about one and a half times as wide as they are tall, seen exactly from above, completely flat, no furniture, no objects, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
